There is no direct evidence of 1p/19q codeletion status.

These features are more typical of higher-grade gliomas. The presence of IDH mutation (predicted above) does not preclude a high grade; IDH mutant glioblastomas (WHO Grade 4) exist. The combination of these aggressive features and the patient's age suggests a high-grade tumor.
